name: Half-Elf
text:
## Half-Elf Racial Traits

- **+2 to One Ability Score**: Half-elf characters get a +2 bonus to one ability score of their choice at creation to represent their varied nature.
- **Medium**: Half-elves are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
- **Normal Speed**: Half-elves have a base speed of 30 feet.
- **Low-Light Vision**: Half-elves can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
- **Adaptability**: Half-elves receive Skill Focus as a bonus feat at 1st level.
- **Elf Blood**: Half-elves count as both elves and humans for any effect related to race.
- **Elven Immunities**: Half-elves are immune to magic sleep effects and get a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.
- **Keen Senses**: Half-elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.
- **Multitalented**: Half-elves choose two favored classes at 1st level and gain 1 additional hit point or skill point whenever they take a level in either one of those classes.
- **Languages**: Half-elves begin play speaking Common and Elven. Half-elves with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic).

feats.name: Skill Focus ({choice:skill-focus})
feats.description:
Choose a skill. You are particularly adept at that skill.

**Benefit**: You get a +3 bonus on all checks involving the chosen skill. If you have 10 or more ranks in that skill, this bonus increases to +6.

**Special**: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new skill.

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1 foot to the range increment of the alchemist's thrown splash weapons (including the alchemist's bombs). favoredClassOptions.description: When casting arcanist enchantment spells, add 1/3 to the effective caster level, but only for the purpose of determining duration.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a spell's duration is not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1/4 to the bonus on Reflex saves and dodge bonus to AC against attacks made by traps granted by trap sense.

Increase the bonus gained from blood sanctuary by 1/4.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: blood sanctuary's bonus is adjusted on the class feature

favoredClassOptions.description: Add 1 to the brawler’s CMD when she’s resisting a trip or overrun combat maneuver.

Add +1 foot to the cavalier's mount's base speed. This option has no effect unless the cavalier has selected it 5 times (or another increment of 5); a speed of 54 feet is effectively a speed of 50 feet, for example. If the cavalier ever replaces his mount, the new companion gains this base speed bonus.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the mount's speed is on its own sheet

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1/3 to the amount of damage dealt or damage healed when the cleric uses channel energy.

favoredClassOptions.description: Add a +1/4 bonus on caster level checks to remove afflictions (curses, diseases, poisons, etc.).

Select one cleric domain power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the druid's Wisdom modifier. The druid adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that domain power. For druids whose nature bond gives them an animal companion, add +1 skill rank to the animal companion. If the druid ever replaces her animal companion, the new companion gains these bonus skill ranks.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the domain power is the player's pick, and the animal companion's skill ranks are on its own sheet

Add 1 foot to the hunter’s companion’s base speed. In combat, this has an effect only for every five increases in base speed.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the companion's speed is on its own sheet

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1/4 to the number of times per day the inquisitor can change her most recent teamwork feat.
